name: stream-machine-hyperframes
description: Author animated stream overlays as HTML and show them in OBS.

interface.longDescription: Teaches the agent to write an animated overlay as one HTML composition, build it into a single self-contained file with a bundled script, and load it in OBS as a browser source through the Stream Machine OBS plugin. Includes a lower-third template. Needs Node.js 20+ or Bun; no server runs.
defaultPrompt: Make me a lower third overlay and show it in OBS.
